name: PSF model (PSFEx-like)
description: Spatially varying PSF from the field stars (polynomial of order 0-3, analytic base + pixel lookup table); graceful fallback with few stars; FWHM/ellipticity/PA maps and catalog columns; the model can be used by PSF photometry, crowded photometry, DAOPHOT, multi-component fits and tiled ZOGY.

params.name: kind
params.label: PSF function
params.help: empirical = pixel lookup table; gaussian / moffat / lorentz / penny = analytic base (+ lookup table).

params.name: order
params.label: Spatial order
params.help: Polynomial order of the variation across the image (0-3); reduced automatically with few stars (< 20 stars: constant, < 60: linear, < 150: quadratic).

params.name: oversample
params.label: Oversampling
params.help: Sampling of the model grid; auto = 2 with >= 25 stars (accurate sub-pixel shifts), else 1.

params.name: fwhm
params.label: FWHM prior (px)
params.help: Prior FWHM: stamp size, isolation distance and the Gaussian fallback when no star is found.

params.name: snr-min
params.label: Min. peak S/N
params.help: Peak signal-to-noise a PSF star needs.

params.name: max-stars
params.label: Max. stars
params.help: Maximum number of PSF stars (brightest first).

params.name: saturation
params.label: Saturation level (0 = none)
params.help: Peak value above which a star is excluded.

params.name: grid
params.label: Map grid
params.help: Grid size of the FWHM / ellipticity maps in the info file and plot.
